Mutant Feature - Dog Head.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Dog Head
A furred dog head with a muzzle and black nose on a human body.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Dog Head.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual selection only: a permanent Mutant feature of the body; keep it consistent in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two selected features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. If Quirkless or No Quirk was chosen, there is no heteromorph body: do not draw this feature.

Portrait: a dog's head on a human neck and body: a medium-length muzzle, black nose, dark lips, upright triangular ears that fold at the tips, and short fur over the whole head. The fur follows the selected hair color, the eyes the selected eye color. Hair Style traits shape longer fur on the crown and nape where they can; facial hair traits are skipped. If another Mutant Feature adds ears, a beak or tusks, this head's own anatomy takes precedence.
